title: Burford's Head of Business Architecture and Enablement shares insights on AI and process engineering
summary: A thoughtful approach to AI adoption starts with evaluating workflows. Process engineering can also improve efficiency, reduce duplicative spending and support lasting organizational change. The Legal Innovation Spotlight podcast features John Barbera, Burford’s Head of Business Architecture & Enablement, in which he discusses these topics and more. Learn more.
body_markdown:
A thoughtful approach to AI adoption starts with evaluating workflows. Process engineering can also improve efficiency, reduce duplicative spending and support lasting organizational change. The *Legal Innovation Spotlight* podcast features John Barbera, Burford’s Head of Business Architecture & Enablement, in which he discusses these topics and more.
